_comment: Radiance x0 patch-16 MULTI-GPU pipeline parallelism WITH weight streaming, FULL fine-tune. See radiance/train.py. The fp32 masters (~38 GB), grad accumulators, pinned .grad buffers and AdamW state (~190 GB total) all live in HOST RAM; each GPU holds only (window+pin) chunks of weights plus its activations. This is the config for full-FT at resolutions where resident pipeline stages OOM.
_comment_chunks: fp32 chunks are 2x the bf16 size, so both the H2D window and the D2H gradient traffic double. offload_grad_accum='stream' keeps that off the critical path: gradients accumulate on the GPU and cross PCIe once per step at flush instead of once per microbatch. Start with backward='checkpoint' (cheapest activation memory) and only switch to 'keep'+offload_activations if there is VRAM to spare — the NeRF head's generated-weight tensors make that unlikely above 512px.
_comment_batch: batch_size is PER MICROBATCH; effective batch = batch_size * n_microbatches.
_comment_ckpt: Path to the Radiance x0 patch-16 base weights (safetensors, native flow keys, 659 tensors). See checkpoints/README.md.
_comment_mode: full mode resume priority: full_checkpoint > lora_checkpoint (merged into radiance_checkpoint) > radiance_checkpoint.
